name: plugin.shim_harness_governor
description: Shim Universal AI Harness Governor plugin providing 4-tier tool permission & symlink containment auditing, deterministic-first allowlisted slash command routing, MCP namespacing & env-ref config checks, and bounded session/4-tier skill loading
author: Brain Harness Authors

entrypoints.name: shim_audit_tool_execution
entrypoints.description: Audit 4-tier permission modes, closed additionalProperties=false schemas, ancestor symlink workspace containment, and file/shell caps

parameters.name: tool_level
parameters.description: Tool capability level (read, write, shell, external)

parameters.name: target_path
parameters.description: Target file or command working directory path

parameters.name: tool_schema
parameters.description: Optional JSON schema inspected for additionalProperties=false

parameters.name: confirmed
parameters.description: Interactive confirmation flag for ask mode

entrypoints.name: shim_route_command
entrypoints.description: Route operator command deterministically before bounded MaxTokens=300 compilation and closed /command allowlist verification

parameters.name: raw_input
parameters.description: Raw operator text or slash command

parameters.name: llm_compiled_command
parameters.description: Optional fallback command string emitted by compiler LLM

parameters.name: compiler_max_tokens
parameters.description: Token cap applied to compiler LLM fallback

entrypoints.name: shim_audit_mcp_discovery
entrypoints.description: Sanitize MCP tool names to <=64 chars with collision detection, audit 30s/60s timeouts, verify api_key_env indirection, and sort 900ms local endpoints

parameters.name: tool_names
parameters.description: Tool names exposed by the MCP server

parameters.name: call_timeout_seconds
parameters.description: MCP tool call timeout in seconds

parameters.name: config_payload
parameters.description: Optional provider configuration payload inspected for api_key_env compliance

entrypoints.name: shim_audit_session_skills
entrypoints.description: Validate JSONL session ID format and 0o700/0o600 permissions, MaxSteps=16 and 64 KiB AGENTS.md caps, and 4-tier last-wins skill loading

parameters.name: skill_candidates
parameters.description: Skill candidate descriptors with name, tier, size_bytes, and has_closed_frontmatter

parameters.name: scanner_max_bytes
parameters.description: JSONL line scanner ceiling in bytes

parameters.name: agents_md_bytes
parameters.description: Byte length of loaded AGENTS.md instructions
